findings.explanation: Line 1 (Äpplen, 13.5 kg at 312.00) is priced at the case price (13 kg x 24.00/kg), not a per-kg price. Per the contract, per-kg items are charged by net weight, so the line appears to be billed per case rather than per kg.
findings.quote: Items in Annex A marked per kilogram are charged by net weight. Cases and boxes are packaging only and never a unit of charge for such items.
